verdict.rationale: Adyen's first-party docs describe the full purchase flow for agents. Agent platforms can run the complete ACP and UCP checkout flow, and Adyen returns a created session with totals and fulfillment options. Adyen tokenizes shopper credentials into ACP/UCP tokens tied to the session and merchant, which the merchant uses to process payment, and it orchestrates stock, tax, shipping and payment authorization so shoppers can complete transactions inside the agent. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented order-confirmation step (it is only implied by authorization and complete-transaction language), and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
